title: 第19章 带回楚依依说服李如风第20章 出手救治秒杀血手
slug: 开局亿年修为弹指间秒杀一切
content_zh:
“是她！是她！就是她！”
在徐洋疑惑不解中，姬无道指着地上的楚依依就是激动道。
“啪！”
“哎吆，师兄，你打我干嘛？”
随着一声巴掌声响起，姬无道立马捂着头对徐洋质问道。
“你说呢？”
“你说话能不能说清楚点？”
“还是说你们神算子，都是这么欠揍的？”
“什么就是她？她又是谁啊？”
徐洋淡淡开口道。
“……”
“那也没必要打我吧……”
“算了，正事要紧。”
“我的意思是，这人就是我说的大气运之人。”
“只是没想到她竟然会服用禁药，这下可就麻烦了。”
“好不容易碰到一个有缘人继承我的任务，结果是个快死之人……”
姬无道有些欲哭无泪道。
“啊？就是她？”
“那有办法能救她吗？”
“只要能救活她，事情不就迎刃而解了？”

徐洋也没有想到眼前躺在地上的女子，竟然就是姬无道推算出来的大气运之人。
“师兄，你听听你在说什么虎狼之词？”
“要是这么容易救活，那还能叫做禁药？”
“反正我是没办法，我可以发个消息回去问问我父亲，说不定他知道一些。”
“但我估计没戏，毕竟就算有办法可以救她，估计需要的东西也肯定很珍贵。”
“你也知道我们东荒是最弱的一片区域，那是要什么没什么。”
“若是在中都，说不定还有戏。”
姬无道回道。
“你傻啊？”
“这不还有师尊吗？”
“他老人家本事通天，肯定有办法救她的。”
徐洋好似看白痴一样的看着姬无道开口道。
“额……”
“对啊，我怎么把师尊忘了！”
“那还等什么，赶紧把她带到师尊那里。”
“别待会断气了。”
“到时候师尊再厉害，也不可能会起死回生吧。”
被徐洋一提醒，姬无道顿时急切道。
“是啊，确实要赶紧把她带到师尊那里。”
“所以，师弟，你还站着干嘛？”

徐洋看着一脸迫切的姬无道，然后淡淡说道。
“啊？”姬无道明显被徐洋的一番话给弄的有些迷茫。
“啊什么啊？”
content_en:
"It's her! It's her! It's her!"
While Xu Yang was puzzled, Ji Wudao pointed at Chu Yiyi on the ground and said excitedly.
"Crack!"
"Hey, senior brother, why did you hit me?"
As a slap sounded, Ji Wudao immediately covered his head and questioned Xu Yang.
"What do you think?"
"Can you speak more clearly?"
"Or are you good fortune tellers so deserving of a beating?"
"What is she? Who is she?"
Xu Yang said calmly.
"..."
"Then there's no need to hit me..."
"Forget it, business matters."
"I mean, this guy is what I call a lucky guy."
"I just didn't expect that she would take banned drugs. This will cause trouble."
"It's not easy to find a person who is destined to inherit my mission, but it turns out that he is about to die..."
Ji Wudao felt like crying but had no tears.
"Huh? Is that her?"
"Is there any way to save her?"
"As long as we can save her, won't the matter be solved?"
Xu Yang also didn't expect that the woman lying on the ground in front of him was actually a person with great luck as calculated by Ji Wudao.
"Senior brother, listen to what you are saying about tigers and wolves?"
"If it's so easy to revive, can it still be called a banned drug?"
"Anyway, I can't help it. I can send a message back and ask my father. Maybe he knows something."
"But I guess there is no chance. After all, even if there is a way to save her, the things needed must be very precious."
"You also know that our Eastern Wasteland is the weakest area, so it doesn't matter what you want."
"If we were in Zhongdu, there might be something to play."
Ji Wudao replied.
"Are you stupid?"
"Isn't there still a master here?"
"The old man is very capable, and he must have a way to save her."
Xu Yang looked at Ji Wudao as if he were an idiot and said.
"Um..."
"Yes, why did I forget Master!"
"Then what are you waiting for? Take her to Master quickly."
"Don't wait until you die."
"No matter how powerful the master is, he won't be able to come back to life."
As soon as Xu Yang reminded him, Ji Wudao said urgently.
"Yes, we really need to take her to Master as soon as possible."
"So, junior brother, why are you still standing?"
Xu Yang looked at Ji Wudao who looked eager, and then said lightly.
"Ah?" Ji Wudao was obviously confused by Xu Yang's words.
"Ah what?"
